approx.description:
In `resolve`: the unit is a candidate, not the unit the selector was
made for.

identity.description:
In `resolve`: `symbol` when the unit is resolved by its symbol alone
because the selector's stored quote is no longer in the resource.

key.description: Unique within the resource. Stable while the unit is the same unit.

parent.description: Key of the enclosing unit. Absent on the wire means `null`.

range.description: Omitted when the resource is not text.

refuse.description:
In `resolve`: must not be used to create a claim or replace a side.
On a unit of `units`, a candidate or a unit of an ambiguous list,
only `quote_not_distinguishable`: no anchor selects the unit alone,
so its `sel` is not offered as an anchor (section 6.7).

sel.description:
A selector that, sent to `resolve` with the same `loc`, returns
exactly this unit now; for a unit with `refuse:
quote_not_distinguishable`, one that names it among the units it
cannot be told apart from.

Identity.description:
How a unit returned without `approx` was resolved, when not by its full
selector (section 6.7).

oneOf.description:
By its symbol alone: the selector's stored quote is no longer in the
resource.

Range.description:
A unit's place in a text resource (section 4.2): UTF-8 byte offsets,
`start` inclusive, `end` exclusive, 1-based lines.

Refuse.description: Why a resolution must not be used to create a claim or replace a side.

oneOf.description:
The anchored text is identical, with identical in-unit windows, to
another place in the same container (section 6.7).

Selector.description: A selector (spec section 5.2). No key may be null.

count.description:
With `symbol`: how many declarations the symbol named when the
anchor was made. Without `symbol`, with `within`: how many
containers `within` named then. Stored only when that was two or
more.

key.description: A unit key, for providers that address units by key.

prefix.description: Up to 48 characters of the unit's own text before the quote.

quote.description:
Text that occurs in the unit. At most 2,048 characters, and not
only whitespace.

suffix.description: Up to 48 characters of the unit's own text after the quote.

symbol.description: Declaration path in a code resource, as typed.

within.description:
The container of the unit when the anchor was made: a heading path
and piece name, or a declaration's symbol. Added by hibi.
